target: Distinct A-band styles in both modes, typical competitive Arena games ten-plus turns per player; proposed working band 10-14, not a hard minimum or a measured result. Campaign XVII-XX difficult but beatable.

starters.rationale: Reserves and straightforward defense/attacks provide a reliable opening. Shared Crimson Offering delays one Mana; Scent now caps each Aura at three hostile Exposed draws per owner-round. Grade carried forward; reward acquisition may change early campaign tempo. Prior projection retained; no full starter/campaign acquisition simulation in this revision.
Improved Drone and Pulse Pistol help; large-machine setup is still resource hungry. Prior projection retained; no full starter/campaign acquisition simulation in this revision.

Pack damage and blood resources are productive early. Blood Tithe and Adrenal Surge each move one Mana to next turn; total Mana and HP costs are unchanged. Grade carried forward; reward acquisition may change early campaign tempo. Prior projection retained; no full starter/campaign acquisition simulation in this revision.

Efficient suit/cycling pool gives broad early flexibility; pool parity unresolved. Cut the Deck refunds only once per own turn across copies, reducing self-funding cycling. Grade carried forward; reward acquisition may change early campaign tempo. Prior projection retained; no full starter/campaign acquisition simulation in this revision.

Recurring Dagger and efficient Skills provide consistent damage. Rush of Blood+ moves one Mana to next own turn; base is unchanged. Grade carried forward; reward acquisition may change early campaign tempo. Prior projection retained; no full starter/campaign acquisition simulation in this revision.

Two starting totems offer immediate value before row investment. Wellspring and Spirit Offering preserve total Mana but delay part until next own turn. Grade carried forward; reward acquisition may change early campaign tempo. Prior projection retained; no full starter/campaign acquisition simulation in this revision.
Stance sequencing is strong but mistakes can expose the hero. Prior projection retained; no full starter/campaign acquisition simulation in this revision.

Starting Spell Power supplies an early spend/rebuild rhythm. Shared Fault Lines generation and Measured Ruin amplification are lower, even when not the primary engine. Grade carried forward; reward acquisition may change early campaign tempo. Prior projection retained; no full starter/campaign acquisition simulation in this revision.
Small Thralls and slower Fate/Consume development need protection. Prior projection retained; no full starter/campaign acquisition simulation in this revision.
Gun and drink setup can compete, but HP/Hangover management is less forgiving. Prior projection retained; no full starter/campaign acquisition simulation in this revision.

basis: Final bot evaluation and hand-costed revisions. Zero human matches.
